Mon 7/14 — Parity gate & prod deploy
Traced last amount_refunded violation to a January Christ Fellowship dispute; confirmed isolated data gap, asked @Brandon to review a one-row fix
Confirmed cluster commits landed in prod; diagnosed infra dashboard lag as expected behavior
Shared positive staging parity results w/ @Brandon and @Gerry
Tue 7/15 — Charges as SOT prod rollout
Ran parity spot checks across staging apollos_demo, staging Crossroads sandbox, and prod apollos_demo — 100% parity on all three
Proposed prod rollout plan to @Brandon and @Gerry: flag on for Crossroads → Red Rocks → Christ Fellowship → 2-week timer → remove flag for all churches
Confirmed Crossroads 100% parity in prod; flagged that the /transactions tab is dramatically faster (year of data no longer bombing out)
Flagged that refunded charges still showing as "succeeded" in the export is a pre-existing issue; filed it under the Charges as SOT project
Proposed seeding local db with a church that has migrateable charges to help @Austin test sync flows
Weighed in on PR bloat debate in #ai — landed on accepting some bloat if agents + humans both approve
Tue 7/15 (also) — Linear ticket triage
Dropped APO-9432, APO-9428, and APO-9364 into #product as part of a broader discussion on known issues
Thu 7/17 — Admin data/status page bug
Helped triage a /data/status page issue — pointed to the Astronomer polling as the likely culprit; couldn't reproduce in Chrome; asked @Michael for ideas
Weighed in on a dependency bump — suggested going to next major version rather than jumping straight to latest
